posts.title: Do We Need a Modern, Lightweight CSS Toolset?
posts.description: For a while now, I’ve been mildly frustrated with the state of CSS tooling. Sass has served its purpose, but lingers on as little more than a fancy concatenation tool . Lightning CSS was “modern” for a time, but it too feels heavy-handed to me these days. With modern CSS, the tooling we’ve gotten used to has very little work it needs to do anymore. posts.title: Sidecar Update: Cocktails from Bottles You Own
posts.description: It seems nearly every time I show someone Sidecar , my cocktail recipes app, they say “cool” and then ask me if it lets them filter out drinks they can’t make with the bottles they have in their bar.
